## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npm run e2e -- -g <slug>` pass
- [ ] `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and `static/llms.txt` are committed if the build changed them
- [ ] No new dependency, or the maintainer's approval is linked
- [ ] No network calls or HTML injection added (`npm run check` includes the source scan)
- [ ] For a new tool: `help.ts` is written (3–5 steps, 3–6 FAQ entries, US English, original wording)
- [ ] For UI changes: screenshots in light and dark themes
